meta.description: This file containts the guide and steps pertaining to SewerMaxxing in RuneScape 3 only.

getting_started.introduction: Welcome to the SewerMaxxing guide for RuneScape 3. This guide will help you maximize your success while living in the Varrock Sewers.  (Please be aware that this guide is still being created and is not yet completed)
requirements: Basic knowledge of the game mechanics

steps.title: Phase 1: Getting Started
overview: In comparison to OSRS SewerMaxxing, and due to changes in the combat mechanics and scaling, you will be unable to start SewerMaxxing with absolutely nothing.
Instead, you must retain the Bronze Dagger that you get from Tutorial Island, and you can safely drop everything else before descending below.
Pay close attention to you character's Abilities, as the regular useage of both 'Regenerate' and 'Assault' will be particularly useful at these early levels.

A good cycle to get into at low level is to attack low level enemies to collect Adrenaline, use the Adrenaline to Regenerate any lost HP (repeating as many times as necessary to refill your HP bar), then using the same technique to collect more Adrenaline to take into your next higher level monster fight.
Using this technique wil allow you to use abilities like Assault straight away without havin to wait for Adrenaline to build up.

objectives.description: Reach at least level 15 in Attack, Strength and Defence. This will put you in a healthy position to advance to the next phase with th higher levelled monsters.
Without reliable access to a Tinderbox or Wood, safely ignore Raw Rat Meat, but do pick up and bury all the Bones that are dropped to help level up your Prayer.
